title: Simplicity Scales
hook: The fancy 12-step plan never gets done. The boring 3-step one does.
explainer: Every extra step is another place to stall or skip. Simple plans are the ones you actually stick to, and sticking to it is what gets results.
sop: List every step in one process or offer.
Cut any step that doesn't directly serve the outcome.
Rebuild it with the fewest steps that still work.
Run it for 2 weeks before adding anything back.
equation_example: Simplicity 9, Consistency 7. 9 × 7 = 63 out of 100. Higher means the plan is simple enough to stick to. A complicated plan drags this number down no matter how hard you work.
question: Pick one thing you've overcomplicated and cut it in half this week.
closing_statement: The simplest version is usually the one that ships.
caption:
Principle Nº 115: Simplicity Scales

The fancy 12-step plan never gets done. The boring 3-step one does.

Complexity kills execution.

Your turn: Pick one thing you've overcomplicated and cut it in half this week.
